method: Three matched pairs on one available Linux llvmpipe host;no video. Resident meshes and accepted lighting ready before capture;warmup durations exported. Seed748291,profile/settings and actual framebuffer recorded. Sustained flight x136..236 is outside spawn preload endingx79. GPU EMA is not a per-frame GPU distribution. Legacy *_cpu_ms and accountedStreamingCpuMs keys measure owner-thread elapsed stage time, including pauses/preemption/driver waits, not thread CPU counters. Opt-in attribution reports thread CPU separately. Baseline lacks whole mesh-owner timing,so accounted baseline mesh cost uses snapshot/upload only.
